definitions.explanation: The act of adjusting or fine-tuning something to achieve the right level, amount, or condition. Used for physical settings like temperature or brightness, as well as abstract adjustments like scheduling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{調節|ちょうせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{室温|しつおん}→室温：25310_shitsuon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{調節|ちょうせつ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm regulating the room temperature with the air conditioner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{調節|ちょうせつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I adjusted the height of the chair to fit my body.

notes:
USAGE:
Used broadly for adjusting physical settings, quantities, or conditions to an appropriate level. Unlike ⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧, which implies bringing something into proper alignment or coordination, {調節|ちょうせつ} focuses on controlling a variable to the desired degree.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧{調節|ちょうせつ} (temperature regulation)
- {光量|こうりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{調節|ちょうせつ} (light adjustment)
- ⟦{体温|たいおん}→体温：03385_taion⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{調節|ちょうせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (regulate body temperature)
- ⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{調節|ちょうせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (adjust speed)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧: adjustment — implies coordinating or fine-tuning to bring into balance, often used for schedules, systems, or interpersonal coordination
- ⟦{制御|せいぎょ}→制御：11816_seigyo⟧: control — stronger, more technical term for managing or governing a system
